title: NBA Prediction Research Findings 2025-2026 — Comprehensive Scan

benchmark_context.note: OUR SYSTEM IS ALREADY COMPETITIVE WITH PEER-REVIEWED LITERATURE on CPU-only tree models. MDPI 2025 CNN paper achieved 0.221 on NBA regular season — our S13 is at 0.22066.
benchmark_context.odds_gods_method: isotonic-calibrated gradient boosting on college basketball 2025

proposals.title: Isotonic Regression Calibration Layer
proposals.details: Fit sklearn CalibratedClassifierCV(method='isotonic') on OOF predictions within the walk-forward loop. The Odds Gods method achieved 0.183 Brier on college basketball using this exact approach. Key: fit calibrator on out-of-fold predictions only to prevent leakage. Current Cat20/Cat23 calibration may use sigmoid — switch to isotonic for larger datasets (9551 games >> 2000 threshold).
proposals.implementation: from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV; cal = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_model, method='isotonic', cv='prefit'); cal.fit(X_oof, y_oof)
proposals.applicable_to: All 6 NBA islands + Political Alpha (both use XGBoost/RF/CatBoost)
proposals.effort: LOW — 1-2 lines of code change in features/engine.py

proposals.title: Travel Direction + Fatigue Features (Cat51)
proposals.source: JCSM travel direction study + CMU 2025 fatigue capstone + Sportsbook Review 2025-26 Fatigue Index
proposals.details: Eastward-traveling teams win 44.51% vs 40.83% for westward teams — a 3.7% win rate swing. Markets partially price this but not fully. Features: travel_direction (east/west), time_zones_crossed (integer), miles_traveled_last_3d (continuous), days_rest (integer), rest_differential (home_rest - away_rest).
proposals.data_source: Schedule data + team city coordinates (already available)
proposals.effort: MEDIUM — compute from schedule, no new API needed

proposals.title: Shot Quality Delta Features (Cat52)
proposals.details: Team actual eFG% minus model-predicted eFG% from shot location/defender distance. Positive delta = hot shooting (unsustainable, mean-reverts). Negative delta on quality shots = buying signal. Also: paint_touch_rate (restricted area attempts / total FGA) and 3PAr (3-point attempt rate for defense).
proposals.data_source: nba_api play-by-play (already in pipeline via Cat19)
proposals.effort: MEDIUM-HIGH — requires expected eFG% model from shot location data

proposals.title: Switch Four Factors Rolling Window to 20 Games
proposals.source: Multiple 2025 papers: PLOS One systematic review + MDPI 2025 feature selection analysis
proposals.details: Rolling 20-game window for Four Factors outperforms 10-game and 30-game windows. Also: split home vs. away stats as SEPARATE features (not combined averages). Home eFG% and away eFG% are different features and should be treated independently.
proposals.action: In features/engine.py: add r20 variants of all Four Factor features. Add home_efg_r20, away_efg_r20 as separate features from combined_efg_r20.
proposals.effort: LOW — config change in rolling window parameters

proposals.title: Dual ELO System (Regular Season + Player-Weighted)
proposals.source: Medium/Football Applied 2025-26 NBA ELO analysis + 2025 analytics community
proposals.details: Maintain two separate ELO ratings per team: (1) fast-updating regular-season ELO (K=20), (2) player-weighted ELO using aggregate EPM/RAPTOR for available roster. Also track opponent-strength-adjusted ELO delta (how much team over/underperforms ELO-implied spread).
proposals.effort: MEDIUM — maintain rolling ELO in data pipeline

proposals.title: Stacked Ensemble Meta-Learner
proposals.source: Scientific Reports 2025 (PMC12357926): stacked LGBM+XGB+RF+LR meta achieves 78% accuracy on 2021-2024 NBA data
proposals.details: Use LGBM + XGBoost + Random Forest as base learners. Add logistic regression or isotonic-calibrated MLP as meta-learner. The key insight: different base models make different types of errors, so stacking is more robust. GA can select (a) feature subset for each base learner and (b) which base learners to include.
proposals.implementation_note: CAUTION: stacking was removed from CPU islands due to compute constraints. Consider adding only on S15 (wide search) as experiment.
proposals.effort: HIGH — architecture change, test on single island first

benchmarks.note: S13 at 0.22066 is already better than MDPI 2025 published benchmark. Isotonic calibration could push to 0.215 range. Combination of P1+P2+P3 could reach target 0.21837.

implementation_priority_order: P1 (isotonic calibration) — lowest effort, highest leverage
P4 (20-game rolling window + home/away splits) — low effort
P2 (travel direction features) — medium effort, novel signal
P3 (shot quality delta) — medium-high effort, strong signal
P6 (stacked ensemble) — high effort, test on S15 only
